title: Per-method environment layer manifest
description: The committed manifest of the per-method environment layer artifacts (plan node method-env-images) and of the per-language base artifacts they stack on. The manifest is generated by scripts/generate-method-env-images.py, never hand-edited; regeneration parity is enforced by scripts/check-method-env-images.sh. Consumers read the manifest as data: the runtime fetches oci_ref@digest, verifies layer_sha256 before mounting, and reports size_bytes before downloading; it fetches the entry's base (bases[], by language and arch) by its tag and verifies squashfs_sha256 before mounting. Design reference: docs/method-env-layer-artifacts.md.

schema_version.description: The manifest shape version. Bump on any breaking field change.

generator_version.description: The version of scripts/generate-method-env-images.py that emitted the file.

source_revision.description: The methods repository commit (12 hex) the entries were generated from. One revision, one manifest.

base_contract.description: The container-contract version the benchmark base images are built under (index.json contract_versions).

bases.description: The app-side base artifacts, one per base and arch, sorted by (base_id, arch). Optional until the committed manifest is regenerated with bases; when present it must give every entry its base (the entry's base_ref/base_digest equal the base's source_ref/source_digest), and every base must be used.

envs.description: One entry per runnable method (index.json runnable: true) per published arch, sorted by env_id.

arch.description: The architecture the layer was built and published for (D09: amd64 only for now).

oci_ref.description: The one OCI package every method layer is published in, without tag or digest (the tag/digest are separate fields); the method is in the tag.

tag.description: The immutable publish tag <env_id>-<method_version>-<arch> in the layer package.

digest.description: The OCI content digest of the artifact manifest. The runtime fetches oci_ref@digest.

layer_sha256.description: sha256 of the published layer.squashfs bytes; verified offline before mount.

size_bytes.description: The layer.squashfs byte length; shown by the download rows before the download starts.

base_ref.description: The benchmark base image the delta was computed against (the method Dockerfile's FROM base).

base_digest.description: The digest of that benchmark base image; the pairing anchor (com.txr.trimmed-from-digest).

wrapper_code_sha256.description: sha256 of the byte concatenation of /code/method.json then the wrapper file (/code/run.R or /code/run.py).

layer_schema.description: LAYER_SCHEMA_VERSION, mirrored from the /.txr-method-env-layer-schema marker inside the squashfs (DEC-11).

base_id.description: The base id (the first part of its tag) and the env id the app's env manager keys the base under.

arch.description: The architecture the base was packed for.

oci_ref.description: The one OCI package both bases are published in (the sandbox's base package), without tag or digest; the base is in the tag.

tag.description: The immutable publish tag <base_id>-<contract>-<arch>-<first 12 hex of squashfs_sha256> in the base package: one tag per distinct base file.

digest.description: The OCI content digest of the base's artifact manifest bytes (design §6.3); the publisher's resolve check.

squashfs_sha256.description: sha256 of the published base.squashfs bytes; the runtime verifies the downloaded, staged or cached base file against it.

source_ref.description: The benchmark base image the squashfs was packed from; equals the base_ref of every entry it pairs with.

source_digest.description: That image's digest (com.txr.trimmed-from-digest); equals the base_digest of every entry it pairs with.
